Our EMEA Accounting AM team manages a book worth tens of millions in ARR across the region's leading audit and accounting firms, and we believe that book can double. It will come from moving customers onto our AI and Agents platform, defending against cheaper point solutions and free AI tools, and handling firms that keep acquiring each other. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers. jobs.description: Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn. Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig. Wat ga je doen? Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf. Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value. Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers. Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf. Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg. Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar. jobs.description: Are you interested in being part of a mission-driven fintech company? WIBS PHP INC. is a BSP-licensed Electronic Money Issuer EMI and Virtual Asset Service Provider VASP company in the Philippines. We are building a secure, compliant, and transparent digital finance ecosystem that supports modern payment, wallet, and virtual asset services. As we continue to grow, we are looking for an Internal Audit Associate who can help evaluate internal controls, review operational processes, test compliance with company policies, identify control weaknesses, and support audit reporting and follow-up activities. This role is suitable for candidates who want to grow in internal audit, risk management, compliance review, internal control, governance, and audit documentation within a regulated fintech company. You do not need to be a crypto expert. However, you must be willing to learn how internal audit, compliance, finance, operations, and risk management work in an EMI/VASP environment. What You’ll Do Internal Audit and Control Testing Assist in planning, performing, and documenting internal audit procedures. Review business processes, internal controls, and operational procedures. Test whether departments follow approved policies, procedures, and control activities. Check the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of documents, records, and supporting evidence. Identify control weaknesses, process gaps, documentation issues, and potential risk areas. Assist in validating whether corrective actions were properly implemented. Risk, Governance, and Compliance Review Support reviews related to operational risk, financial controls, compliance processes, and governance procedures. Assist in checking whether company activities are aligned with internal policies and regulatory expectations.
